title: SAMPLE STUDENT HANDBOOK
notice: Example policies for document-processing practice. These are fictional examples and are not official college rules.

sections.example_policy: Students are encouraged to attend all scheduled classes. An instructor may ask a student to discuss repeated absences.
Students should arrive before the published examination start time and bring their campus identification card. The examination office should publish permitted materials in advance.
A course grade may be based on assignments, participation, and examinations. Instructors should explain the grading breakdown at the start of the course.
Students are expected to treat classmates and staff respectfully and to avoid disrupting learning activities. Concerns may be reported to the student support office.
Students should carry their campus ID while on campus. A lost card should be reported to the campus services desk so the card can be replaced.
Library users should keep noise low, return borrowed items by their due dates, and follow staff instructions. Food and drink should be kept away from library materials.
Students should review fee statements and payment dates issued by the finance office. Questions about a charge may be directed to that office.
A student who needs leave should notify the appropriate academic office and follow the leave request steps published by the institution.
Students should follow posted safety instructions, keep exits clear, and report hazards to campus security or facilities staff.
